title: The calendar is a code
governingQuestion: How does Paris turn institutional recognition into a technical access system?
status: evidence-backed production draft; recording, interviews and owner-final approval remain open

longform.headline: The calendar is a code
longform.opening: Before Paris shows a garment, it codes who belongs on the calendar.

sections.heading: Then
sections.copy: FHCM coordinates Paris Fashion Week and publishes the official calendar; its history traces the federation to the Chambre Syndicale founded in 1868.

sections.heading: Now
sections.copy: The public calendar, accreditation portal and institutional designations are related but distinct permissions: visibility is not admission.

sections.heading: Next—and the limit
sections.copy: No public source reviewed establishes the guest-list software, identity checks or security stack for every forthcoming house presentation.

longform.closing: Paris Fashion Week is not one technology. It is a chain of permissions that turns recognition into circulation and circulation into memory.
